name: Jigoku no Hanayome - Texas no Kouya ni Kyoufu no Hitokui Ikka o Ou!
original_name: 地獄の花嫁 テキサスの荒野に恐怖の人喰い一家を追う!
source:
Sarah Ducasse is a (reluctant) female talent working for a Florida-based video production company.
Today, like most days, she’s participating in the filming of some questionable content. Meanwhile, her boss, Robert Lowe, is drowning in debt and on the verge of collapse.
In a desperate move, Robert agrees to a proposal from his creditors: a feature on a cannibal family lurking in the Texas wilderness. It’s the kind of project that makes everyone wonder, Is there even a demand for this kind of thing anymore?
Despite Sarah’s vehement protests, the team heads to the Texas wilderness, setting up base at a motel in Eldorado. They begin filming their sham of a show, but on the very first night, a mysterious giant man breaks into Sarah’s room…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ351843.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
莎拉·迪卡斯是一家佛罗里达影视制作公司的女艺人——虽然她本人并不情愿。
今天，她照例参与着某些可疑内容的拍摄。与此同时，老板罗伯特·洛已经债台高筑，濒临崩溃。
走投无路之下，罗伯特答应债主的提议，前往得克萨斯荒野，拍摄潜伏在那里的一户食人家族。这种企划，恐怕谁都会怀疑，如今真的还有人想看吗？
尽管莎拉极力反对，团队仍出发前往得克萨斯，在埃尔多拉多的一家汽车旅馆安顿下来，开始拍摄他们那场弄虚作假的节目。然而，就在第一天夜里，一个神秘的巨汉闯进了莎拉的房间……
